projects.title: The Heart of the Mountain
projects.description:
On the picturesque heights of the Qafshtama mountain, located at an impressive elevation of 1350 meters, a pristine spring known as "Natural Mineral Water of Qafshtama" emerges. 

Our mission was clear: to strengthen the presence of Uji Qafshtama in the market. We adopted a multifaceted approach that not only emphasized water quality but also the experience of embracing nature's bounty.
